WITH filtered_trans AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
            WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
            ELSE NULL
        END AS signed_amount,
        balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE amount >= 2400
),
account_avgs AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN signed_amount IS NOT NULL THEN signed_amount END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM filtered_trans
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_across_accounts,
    AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance_across_accounts
FROM account_avgs
